name: title-case-converter-extension
description: Browser extension to convert text to title case

scripts.build:chrome: node scripts/build-assets.js chrome && node scripts/build.js chrome
scripts.build:firefox: node scripts/build-assets.js firefox && node scripts/build.js firefox
scripts.build: pnpm run clean && pnpm run build:assets && node scripts/build.js chrome && node scripts/build.js firefox
scripts.verify: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
